footer.privacy: Your video never leaves your computer and nothing is saved.

discard.title: Discard these subtitles?
discard.body: You have not downloaded the subtitles for this video yet. If you start over, they will be lost.

home.title: Subtitles for your video, without the hassle
home.subtitle: Pick the video, subtitles are generated on your computer, you review while watching and download. No sign-up, nothing to install.

perks.private: The video stays on your computer

upload.hint: MP4, WebM or MOV · up to {{max}}

errors.format: This file is not a supported video. Use MP4, WebM or MOV.
errors.tooLarge: The file is {{size}}. The limit is {{max}}.
errors.unplayable: Your browser cannot play this video. Convert it to MP4 (H.264) and try again.

upload.warnLarge: Large file ({{size}}). Transcription may be slow.

how.title: How to make your subtitles
how.subtitle: Four steps, from video to finished file.

choose.title: Pick the video
choose.description: Drag the file onto the page or click Select video.

generate.title: Generate subtitles
generate.description: Tell us which language is spoken and click Generate subtitles. Transcription runs on your computer.

review.title: Review while watching
review.description: Subtitles show over the video as it plays. Spotted a mistake? Click the text and fix it right there.
review.caption: Click here to fix

download.title: Download and done
download.description: Take just the subtitle file or the subtitled video, in the style you like.
download.burn: Video with subtitles in the image

transcribe.explain: Subtitles are generated right here on your computer. Long videos may take a few minutes.
transcribe.slowBrowser: In this browser, subtitles take longer to be ready.
transcribe.importError: This subtitle file could not be read. Use a valid .srt or .vtt.
transcribe.runningHint: You can keep using your computer. Do not close this tab.
transcribe.failed: Could not generate subtitles for this video. Try again.
transcribe.noSpeech: No speech found in this video. Check the selected language or import subtitles.

leave.title: Cancel processing?
leave.body: The running transcription will be cancelled if you leave this screen.
